requirement: Issue and verify service API keys where the server stores only a keyed digest of each secret, compares in constant time, and supports revocation.
skeleton: An InvalidKeyError, and an ApiKeyStore holding a validated pepper and a digest map, with an HMAC digest helper, issue, verify parsing and constant-time checking the key, and revoke.
caption: An API key store that hands out keys generated with secrets but keeps only peppered HMAC digests, so a leaked database reveals no usable keys. InvalidKeyError is a plain Exception. ApiKeyStore(pepper) raises ValueError when the pepper is shorter than 32 bytes. Its _digest helper is hmac.new over the secret with the pepper and hashlib.sha256. issue makes an id with secrets.token_hex(4) and a secret with token_urlsafe(32), stores the digest under the id and returns sk_ plus the id, an underscore and the secret. verify raises InvalidKeyError saying malformed key without the sk_ prefix or with no underscore or empty secret, and saying unknown key when the id is missing or hmac.compare_digest fails, else returns the id. revoke deletes the id, raising KeyError when unknown. The fixture asserts the key format and verification, that no plaintext secret is stored, that tampered, unknown or other-pepper keys are unknown, malformed keys, a single compare_digest call, revocation, and the pepper length.

plan.intent: Authenticate API clients without storing their keys
constraints: Peppers shorter than 32 bytes raise ValueError
Keys are sk_, an 8 hex id, an underscore and a 32 byte urlsafe secret
Malformed and unknown keys raise InvalidKeyError
Revoking an unknown id raises KeyError

rationale.teaches: Split keys into a lookup id and a secret, store a peppered HMAC of the secret, and verify with compare_digest after strict parsing.
rationale.why: Storing raw keys turns any database leak into full account takeover, and byte comparison with != leaks timing information about the digest.

ops.docstring: Issue API keys with secrets and store only peppered HMAC digests.

ops.source:
class InvalidKeyError(Exception):
    """Raised when a presented API key is malformed, unknown or revoked."""

candidates.why_wrong: Keys carry only 16 random bytes instead of the required 32.
Digests are compared with != which short-circuits and leaks timing.
An unknown key id crashes with TypeError instead of InvalidKeyError.
Revoking an unknown id is silently ignored instead of raising KeyError.
A key with an empty secret part is reported as unknown instead of malformed.
